q: What CBAM figure does an EU buyer need for rebar and wire rod from Zenica?
title: Zenica rebar and wire rod: the CBAM figure
short: Zenica is an integrated blast furnace works, so its long products carry coke, sinter and furnace emissions, well above scrap based mills. Ask for a verified figure per tonne of product and period. Bosnia and Herzegovina has no carbon price to deduct.
audience: EU importers and traders buying long steel from Bosnia and Herzegovina

ul: Billet casting and rod or bar mill fuel.

p: Reported, not charged, for steel. Bosnia's grid is coal heavy.
The importer uses EU default values, set high on purpose. A measured figure is worth getting.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
